svg.title: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy: chronic and gestational hypertension, split by onset before or after 20 weeks, where the blood pressure is the problem and is treated with oral drugs, against pre-eclampsia, eclampsia and HELLP syndrome, where it is a symptom, severe pressure is lowered with intravenous drugs, magnesium sulfate prevents seizures and complications decide delivery
